item.title: Key US ally blocks airspace to military flights over Iran, escalating standoff with Trump
item.summary: Spain denied U.S. military aircraft access to its airspace and bases for Iran conflict operations, with Defense Minister Robles calling the war "illegal."

item.title: Senators defend two-week recess as record-breaking government shutdown drags on
item.summary: DHS employees remained unpaid as Congress took a recess during the record-breaking shutdown. Sen. Chris Coons defended the break, saying lawmakers are working in home states.

item.title: ‘Inappropriate’ adult attire at Disneyland is 'absolutely sinister,' warns former Biden staffer
item.summary: Yemisi Egbewole said adults wearing revealing clothing at Disneyland reflects a breakdown of unwritten social rules in spaces designed for children.

item.title: 'Warning signs were all there' before deadly DC mid-air crash, former air traffic controller says
item.summary: A former Reagan National controller says safety warnings went unheeded for years before the Jan. 2025 midair crash that killed 67 near the Potomac.

item.title: Trump speaks with the family of Sheridan Gorman, college student allegedly slain by illegal immigrant
item.summary: President Donald Trump spoke with the family of Sheridan Gorman, an 18-year-old allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant in Chicago, a White House official confirmed to Fox News.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie disappearance sparked harrowing 12-hour odyssey for Savannah
item.summary: Savannah Guthrie recounts the frantic 12-hour ordeal after her mother vanished from her Tucson home, with ransom demands and a $1.2M reward offered.

item.title: Leavitt calls on Congress to end Easter recess to work on DHS shutdown
item.summary: The White House urges Congress to return from Easter recess to fund DHS, as TSA staffing shortages and long airport security lines persist nationwide.

item.title: Father loses legal fight to halt euthanasia of 25-year-old daughter in Spain
item.summary: Noelia Castillo Ramos' case reached the European Court of Human Rights before 25-year-old died in Barcelona on March 26, 2025.

item.title: Rubio gains early momentum in hypothetical 2028 GOP primary race as Vance remains front-runner
item.summary: Marco Rubio surged to 35% in the CPAC 2028 Republican straw poll, jumping from 3% last year, while JD Vance led at 53% amid growing rivalry talk.

item.title: Missing banker’s remains ID’d — again — after beach discovery in decades-old unsolved mystery
item.summary: DNA Doe Project identified human remains found on Salmon Creek Beach as Walter Kinney, a man missing since 1999, in a rare double-identification case.
